caption: A magnet held to a refrigerator is slid down the door, and it slides and stays stuck the whole way.

sa.check: A magnet held to a refrigerator door.
The magnet is slid down the door.
The magnet stays stuck to the door the whole way.
The magnet stays on the door if released at the end.

pc.expect: The magnet stays in contact with the door throughout the slide, and holds where it is left when the hand lets go.
pc.fail: The magnet lifts off the door during the slide; or drops when released; or slides on by itself after the hand stops; or stands off the door at a gap.

pc.expect: The magnet moves only as pushed; if it comes off the door it falls straight down.
pc.fail: The magnet floats away from the door; or rises up the door with no hand on it; or hangs in the air after coming off; or drifts sideways away from the door.

pc.expect: The magnet moves only while the hand pushes it; other magnets and papers on the door stay put.
pc.fail: The magnet slides on after the hand has stopped; or moves before the hand touches it; or other magnets on the door slide or drop; or the door swings open.

pc.expect: The magnet stays a rigid piece; the door's surface stays flat and undented along the slide.
pc.fail: The magnet squashes or smears along the door; or the door dents or ripples where the magnet passes; or the magnet stretches.

pc.expect: One magnet on the outside of the door; it does not sink into the door; the hand passes through nothing.
pc.fail: The magnet sinks into the door; or a second magnet appears along the path; or the magnet vanishes; or the fingers pass through the magnet.

pc.expect: The magnet's colour and design and the other items on the door stay the same.
pc.fail: The magnet changes colour or shape; or notes on the door change; or the door changes colour.
